title: Law to create small business incubators in public housing
summary: This bill would require the Department of Small Business Services to run a three-year pilot program placing at least one small business incubator in a public housing facility in each borough. The incubators' services would be tailored based on studies of residents' business interests and needs, with at least half of offerings during evenings or weekends. The department must report annually to the Council speaker and mayor on participant demographics, challenges faced and program outcomes.
